metadata.name: Note review pipeline — a graph that calls another class
metadata.description: The smallest graph that hands its work to another problem class: one subgraph node that opens a child job of the class nota-curta and takes the child's text back. It pins no skill and opens no session of its own.
metadata.source: a manual port (the subgraph node's example)

nodes.description: Opens a child job of the class nota-curta about the job's own title and collects the finished note.

checks.description: The child job handed back an output.
